authorization: user continuation of ARS research and model planning; root admits only bounded source-semantic validation, no timing/performance/RTL/native experiment

source_rules.1522-1528: successful submit increments qdepth/submitted; count limit sets draining
source_rules.1533-1542: callback decrements qdepth and increments io_completed, including error callbacks
source_rules.1566-1573: draining frees this task/buffer; otherwise resubmit same task
source_rules.1581-1601: error completion marks failure, then task_complete; counts alone do not prove success
source_rules.1843-1859: final drain must retire remaining requests

projection.N_and_Q_role: small verification constants, not a sourced workload/deployment or speed claim
projection.buffer_pool: one stable opaque buffer per initial task; resubmission keeps same buffer and increments generation
projection.count_target: N successfully submitted command instances; error-free success requires N successfully completed instances
projection.completed_rule: preserve source io_completed versus successful_completed separately
projection.drain_rule: after Nth successful submission no new submissions, final pending completions release all tasks

state_space: enumerate source-interface-permitted choices among active task callbacks; overapproximation, not proof every order occurs on NVMe hardware
prototype_checks: exact N submissions/completions in error-free episode
qdepth <= Q with generation identity and stable task buffer
no reuse before completion; no free before final completion or while pending
finite-count drain and all buffers released
success decoding ignores phase bit, checks SC/SCT; any error invalidates successful-run evidence
changing callback order recomputes subsequent submissions; fixed arrival list is not universally reusable
negative_cases: error callback mislabeled successful full episode
outputs: new model/ code plus synthetic traces and verification receipts; never overwrite old M0 or claim original application measurement
performance_model_admission: still pending source/action/mapping/service evidence; semantic prototype result cannot satisfy opposite-sign H-D gate
